cards.title: Consumers
text: Buying or selling a home? Vaughn Law is here for you.

cards.title: Real Estate Transactions
text: Contracts, title searches, financing, leasing and more, for personal and commercial real estate.

cards.title: Deeds and Conveyances
text: The type of deed you use decides who owns what, and how well you are protected.

cards.title: Homestead
text: Florida homestead protections reach beyond the tax discount, to certain creditors and forced sale.

cards.title: Landlord / Tenant
text: We represent landlords in residential matters, and landlords and tenants in commercial ones.

cards.title: Commercial
text: Commercial landlord-tenant disputes, for landlords and tenants alike.

cards.title: Foreclosures
text: Behind on your mortgage? You may have options you have not considered.

cards.title: Bankruptcy
text: Guidance in a financial emergency, including whether Chapter 7 or Chapter 13 might fit.

cards.title: Land Trusts
text: A way to hold title to Florida real property, for homestead and investment property alike.

cards.title: Business Entity Formation
text: Help forming a business entity, or selling and retiring as a seasoned owner.

cards.title: Litigation
text: Civil disputes such as quiet title, partition, breach of contract and boundary disputes.

cards.title: PCCLB
text: Check that your contractor is licensed with both Florida and Pinellas County before you hire.

cards.title: Investors
text: Legal services for real estate investors: closings, contracts, land trusts, foreclosure auctions and more.

cards.title: I'm buying or selling a home.
cards.text: We handle the contract, the title and the closing, with a lawyer at the table.

cards.title: I need to change a deed.
cards.text: Adding a spouse, removing a name, or moving a home into a trust, prepared and recorded the right way.

cards.title: I have a problem with a tenant.
cards.text: Notices, leases and evictions, handled start to finish.

body.text: Vaughn Law is a boutique law firm that provides practical real estate legal solutions for litigation and transactional needs.
We take a more personal, service-oriented approach. We tailor our representation to each client, and the client is always our first priority.

This can be an overwhelming, unfamiliar and stressful time. We help you understand the legal system, keep you informed throughout, and give honest and straightforward opinions on all your options, so you can make fully informed decisions.
Every situation is unique. We have handled many legal cases throughout Florida.
